messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — Hydrangea Therapeutics asked if we can onboard a community adapter (vector connector) for a 3-week POC. They want bandwidth-optimized KV cache and pricing for sustained 200–300 QPS.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Do they want hosted first or Dedicated/Private?
Maya (AE): Hosted initially, but may require Private for PHI later. They want to pin a quantized variant to control cost.
Lee (Infra): Which variant?
Maya (AE): `hydra-open-13b-q4f16` (community). Also asked whether KV cache is per-tenant and how throttling works.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): KV prefix cache is namespaced per-customer. Throttles use token-rate + concurrency limits.
Sam (Sales Eng): Pricing — they asked for a ballpark for 250 QPS sustained, 8k context, quantized model.
Lee (Infra): Quick notes: 13B q4 on our path needs ~16–20GB memory. Sustained 250–300 QPS with low tail latency likely needs Dedicated or heavy batching + high cache hit. With 70% cache hit hosted could work for the short POC but commit recommended for production.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Example config they plan to run:
```yaml
model_variant: hydra-open-13b-q4f16
max_context_tokens: 8192
expected_qps: 250
kv_cache_enabled: true
cache_hit_rate: 0.7
batch_timeout_ms: 10
```
Maya (AE): Can routing fallback to a smaller variant automatically on overload?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Yes — set routing policy primary->hydra-13b-q4 -> fallback->hydra-7b-q4p.
Sam (Sales Eng): Enterprise blockers: KMS integration and security questionnaire.
Lee (Infra): Hosted supports customer-managed keys via our KMS integration for model artifacts and KV. For full HSM in Private, that's a separate workstream. Ask them to submit the standard security pack: https://redwood.internal/sec/sales-pack
Maya (AE): They want POC running inside 3 weeks. Feasible?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Hosted + small Dedicated burst pool can be started in ~2 weeks for onboarding and scale tests. Private will take longer.
Sam (Sales Eng): Pricing options to propose: 1) Hosted PAYG; 2) Dedicated monthly commit; 3) Hybrid dev-hosted + Dedicated POC.
Lee (Infra): Sizing sketch assumptions: 250 sustained QPS, 8k context, 70% cache hit, avg 256 tokens per request.
ops-bot: compute-estimate result: estimated_gpu_hours_per_day=48, recommended_pool=4xA100-equivalent, notes=based on continuous batching and 70% cache hit
Jordan (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a short sizing & validation note.
Lee (Infra): I'll draft capacity sketch and rough price delta hosted vs Dedicated.
Sam (Sales Eng): I'll send the action items to Hydrangea: 1) Fill security pack; 2) Provide model artifact + checksum; 3) Provide workload samples; 4) Confirm KMS needs.
Maya (AE): Thanks — I'll follow up when they send the model link. :thumbsup:
